description: Create a real-money Felix account, like app.felix.trade. The first call reserves one isolated identity, binds its owner, and (until the account's Arc home holds the $5 minimum) returns account_funding_required with deposit_flow: pay with create_deposit, then retry the exact same idempotency_key; it never hands out a Polygon address. Felix then sets up and verifies the Arc home Safe/module, signs the account owner's trading policy locally (the app's device trading policy: no risk limits, Hyperliquid fast-custody trade keys, and Lighter Premium with Felix partner fees, returned in trading_policy), and mints a live key. The $5 deposit does not fund a first live trade: fund the venue with fund_hypercore_from_arc or fund_polymarket_from_arc. No prepaid fee credit is needed; Felix's fee is charged after each fill. Emits progress every 15 seconds. Requires the registered local owner signer and launcher manage key. Cold start: felix://getting-started.

accept_terms.description: Must be true to confirm acceptance of Felix Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and Risk Disclosure.

accept_trading_policy.description: Only after the owner answered yes to the trading_policy_question this tool returned.

delegation_days.description: Delegation duration in days. Defaults to 30; maximum 90.

email.description: Optional new email for the isolated child. Omit to generate an internal identity.

idempotency_key.description: Stable account-creation key. Reuse the exact value after any interruption.

legal_version.description: Current Felix legal bundle version. Omit to use the version bundled with this MCP build.

lifetime_limit_usd.description: Optional Safe delegation lifetime safety ceiling. Defaults/maxes at $1B.

max_daily_loss_usd.description: Optional owner-authorized daily loss safety ceiling. Defaults/maxes at $100M.

max_daily_usd.description: Optional owner-authorized daily notional safety ceiling. Defaults/maxes at the account's $100M daily limit.

max_order_usd.description: Optional owner-authorized per-order safety ceiling. Defaults/maxes at the account's $10M operation limit.

resume_reconciliation.description: Set true only to resume this exact workflow after inspecting an interrupted attempt.

name: create_account
